mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear night skies with a temperature of 78 degrees, feeling like 82. The waxing crescent moon looks beautiful over Fireman's Park, though there are no visible space station flyovers tonight.

The City of Verona is highlighting local sustainability programs. Apartment residents are encouraged to compost by using the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is offering a residential toilet rebate program and rain barrel rebates, alongside free contour maps to help homeowners plan and build their own rain gardens.

We have a wonderful lineup of local events coming up. On July 18, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Also, mark your calendars for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on July 22 at Hometown Junction Park.

In the weekly police report, last Friday morning on July 10, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash at Old PB and Whalen Road. A twenty-four-year-old female cyclist sustained minor injuries, and a Verona driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Cookie, a refreshing blend of cool mint and chocolate cookie pieces. While the store is currently closed, they will reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM, though tomorrow's flavor is currently unknown.
